sentences.text:
3. Learned counsel for the petitioners submit that though pursuant to the notice, they submitted their documents alongwith the petition on 06.04.2023 (Annexure-6 to the petition) and the notice no. 1049 dated 05.10.2023 (Annexure-7 to the petition) also shows their name, the payment has still eluded them.
4.

Learned State Counsel pointed out that vide notice Patna High Court CWJC No.1657 of 2024(2)
dt.10-05-2024 no. 1049 dated 05.10.2023, the District Land Acquisition Officer, Patna, respondent no. 6 has issued notice and the petitioners are required to submit all the relevant documents alongwith their petition.
5. Learned counsel for the petitioners submit that they will be immediately taking up steps by filing a fresh petition alongwith relevant documents.

6. The respondent no. 6, the District Land Acquisition Officer, Patna shall look into his own notice no. 1049 dated 05.10.2023 and if the petitioners submit their separate petition alongwith relevant document within four weeks from today to take the same to its logical conclusion within a period of four months thereafter.
7. It goes without saying that if they are found entitled to the compensation, the same shall be also extended to them within two months thereafter.
8. The writ petition stands disposed of.

(Rajiv Roy, J) kiran/-
